name: Chocolate Pudding No. 1
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Make cornstarch pudding with a quart of milk, three tablespoonfuls of cornstarch and three tablespoonfuls of sugar
When done, remove about half and flavor to taste
To that remaining in the kettle add an egg beaten very light, and four tablespoonfuls of vanilla chocolate grated and dissolved in a little milk
Put in a mold, alternately the dark and light
Serve with whipped cream or boiled custard

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Make cornstarch pudding with a quart of milk, three tablespoonfuls of cornstarch and three tablespoonfuls of sugar
2. When done, remove about half and flavor to taste
3. To that remaining in the kettle add an egg beaten very light, and four tablespoonfuls of vanilla chocolate grated and dissolved in a little milk
4. Put in a mold, alternately the dark and light
5. Serve with whipped cream or boiled custard
